summary: Marwynn Holdings filed an 8-K reporting an October 15, 2026 Software Purchase and Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement with Zhituo Software Co., Limited, a Hong Kong private company. Marwynn acquired Zhituo's Phase 1 core platform of the Marwynn Group Operating Platform plus associated worldwide IP rights, paying solely with 4,000,000 restricted common shares issued under Item 3.02. Ownership passed on the Acquisition Date despite deferred share issuance; Zhituo has 30 days to complete handover, 90-day defect cure, and 15 business-day conformity verification. No advisors or board recommendation disclosed; watch dilution and share valuation implied by the stock consideration.
